neighbours.label: the awaited move of a watched target, told from someone lying in wait (waited until the owners left, waited for the mouse to come out, gained their trust)
fire: The thieves hid in the bushes until the guard walked away.
The cat crouched low and waited for the mouse to come out.
The kidnapper watched the school until the girl stepped outside.
The agent waited patiently for the courier to open the case.
The fox lay still until the hens wandered closer.
The spy befriended the clerk and slowly won his trust.
The robbers waited for the bank manager to unlock the vault.
The stalker sat in his car until she came home.
quiet: The children hid in the bushes and laughed at the game.
The cat curled up on the sofa and fell asleep.
The parents waited outside the school to pick up their kids.
The agent filed the courier's report at the end of the day.
The fox ran across the field toward the forest.
The new clerk joined the office and learned the system quickly.
The customers waited for the bank to open its doors.
The neighbor sat in his car listening to the radio.

notes: Probe: burglar/detective waiting for target to move ~1.0, family waiting for bus ~0.01.
